verdict.rationale: The community reports that Codex and OpenCode installs work by telling the agent to fetch and follow a raw GitHub INSTALL.md (comm-5). The product's skills are plain markdown written for agents to read and follow (probe-rt-1, docs-13), so agent-oriented docs exist in practice. However, no llms.txt is evidenced, and the .md docs probe returned 404 (probe-1). Missing for 10: an llms.txt index, a working markdown docs mirror, and first-party documentation of the agent-fetchable INSTALL.md flow.
